interactionNotes: Screens are assembled from editable Figma frames and text nodes
Response-state frames are design references; the application chooses them from validation, request status and API data, not navigation buttons on primary screens
Each standard screen has a vertically scrollable content viewport and fixed bottom navigation for 5 main tabs
Prototype links are generated from route fields in design.json; they illustrate navigation, not backend behavior
The selected band is content preference, not verified IELTS level
Example content is illustrative, not production lesson content
Admin entry is role-gated and writing feedback actions appear only when the feedback job is ready; neither is shown on the learner/pending default frames
mergePolicy: Import all 113 screens on a new page; never delete, replace, or modify existing pages.
